title: compat(openai): partial-dispatch support for streaming tool_choice + graceful fallback and schema alignment
author: Diego Alvarez
description: Context: OpenAI-style tool/function calling remains a major integration point for customer workloads. We observed two recurring issues in the compatibility shim: 1) long-running streaming responses where the model decides on a tool mid-stream (partial tool_choice) produced inconsistent framing and occasionally caused client disconnects; 2) when a tool schema in the compatibility catalog diverged slightly from the model's schema name/shape, the runtime fell back too aggressively to text output, losing structured output semantics. This PR introduces a targeted compatibility layer to make partial tool_choice streaming first-class and to perform tolerant schema alignment during handoff. Summary of changes: - Streaming protocol: emit explicit tool_choice.hint frames and tool_choice.commit frames in the OpenAI-framed event stream so downstream SDKs (TS/Python/Go) can render an in-progress tool invocation UI and then commit when the model decides. Hints are non-terminal and include a suggested tool id + partial args payload (encrypted/hashed if configured). - Fallback semantics: add a new policy 'graceful_invoke_fallback' which, if the selected tool is unavailable or schema-mismatched, continues streaming the tool invocation envelope (function-call style) instead of abruptly switching to plain text. This preserves structured output and allows clients to present a retry UI or queue the invocation. - Schema alignment: introduce schema similarity matching (name aliasing, field-level relaxed matching, and a best-effort mapping layer) at the dispatcher so small mismatches don't force a textual fallback. The mapping is conservative by default and opt-in via the compatibility config. - Backwards compatibility: the new frames are additive and ignored by older clients; we added a registry flag to disable hints for customers who want strict parity. - Tests & CI: unit tests for the dispatcher and decoder, integration test that reproduces the previous regression with partial tool_choice across a streaming boundary, and e2e with the TS SDK to assert the commit frame ordering. Motivation: these changes reduce incidents where user-facing apps lost structured tool call semantics mid-stream and improves developer experience for SDK consumers of the OpenAI compatibility layer. See linked Linear tickets. Checklist: - [x] Implement streaming frames and decoder support - [x] Add dispatcher-side fallback policy - [x] Add schema alignment utilities and docs toggle - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Run CI and iterate on flakiness fixes - [x] Update compatibility docs and SDK adapters Notes: kept the compatibility opt-in for conservative customers and added telemetry events so we can measure invocation vs fallback rates. Rolling this out behind a feature flag in the control plane is planned to minimize blast radius.

diff_snippets: src/compat/openai_tool_dispatcher.rs: added ToolChoiceHint and ToolChoiceCommit enums plus graceful_invoke_fallback policy handling
runtime/streaming/frame_decoder.py: decoder now accepts 'tool_choice.hint' and 'tool_choice.commit' event types and preserves ordering metadata
sdk/ts/openai_compat_adapter.ts: new onToolHint/onToolCommit callbacks exposed to consumers
review_thread: Priya Nair: Can we make the hint payload size-bounded to avoid blowing up streaming memory? -> Diego: yes, limited to 4KB by default (configurable).

Jonas Meyer: The schema alignment looks powerful but risky; suggest opt-in and telemetry. -> Diego: added opt-in toggle and telemetry events 'compat.schema_align.attempt'/'compat.schema_align.applied'.
Evelyn Park: CI flakes in the integration test on arm64. -> Diego: added deterministic seeds and a retry wrapper in the test harness; CI stabilized.
release_notes: Add explicit streaming frames for partial tool selection (tool_choice.hint / tool_choice.commit), a graceful fallback policy to preserve structured tool invocations when exact tool/schema matches are unavailable, and a conservative schema-alignment option behind a compatibility toggle. Opt-in by default; telemetry added.
notes_for_release: Feature behind control-plane flag. Recommend enabling for staged customers to measure fallback rates before global rollout. SDKs upgraded to surface hint/commit callbacks in minor versions.
incidents_reference: SUP-4821 reproducer linked; fix reduces customer incidents related to mid-stream tool selection losing structured output.
risk_and_mitigation: Low-medium: changes are additive. Mitigations include opt-in toggle, conservative default mapping, telemetry, and a rollback feature flag in the control plane.
test_plan: Unit tests for dispatcher and decoder. Integration test that replays an LLM stream which switches to tool_choice mid-response. E2E with TS SDK asserting UI callback ordering. Load smoke test on staging to verify latency impact.
